g.text: Runs on every pull request and every push to main
Each job's steps run in order and stop at the first failure; unit and integration tests are separate steps.
The security job runs every scan even after a failure, so one run shows all findings; any High finding fails it.
backend, frontend, e2e and security are required checks on main, so a red check blocks the merge.
deliver runs only after every test job and the security job pass; on pull requests it is skipped.
Integration and E2E tests use a throwaway local Supabase, never the hosted project.
Coverage gate: 70% of branches on both sides (the spec's minimum is 50%).
deliver output: pub-order-0.3.<run>-<commit>.zip, kept 90 days; a sprint3 tag also creates a GitHub Release.
Staging: Render (render.yaml) deploys main only after its GitHub checks pass; Supabase keys live in Render, not GitHub.
